request: Dragging the ISO drum slowly sometimes skips a value, on both iPhone and Android. Find where the drum decides which value is selected.

expected.must_mention: Insta and the Nikon engine-port hold copies; the fix belongs in the donor (or opencine once adopted).

request: In Multi View on iPhone, rotating the phone makes every feed reconnect. Where is the tile video host kept alive across layout changes?

expected.must_mention: Host identity is retained by ID; reconnects point at session ownership, not layout.

request: OpenInstaCine shows an iris control for the Luna, which has a fixed aperture. Where does the app decide which controls exist?

expected.must_mention: Change the Luna-owned adapter (kept the Osmo name), not the shared MonitorCapabilities copy, which the Pocket sync overwrites.

request: On OpenPocketCine, false color reads too hot when the camera records D-Log M. Find the code that decides how the log signal is measured.

expected.must_mention: The false-color reading preference is global today, not per source.

request: On the Nikon Android app, closing one camera's session sometimes tears down another camera. Is there an existing fix?

expected.must_mention: The fix exists only on the unmerged engine-port branch; main does not have it.

request: When the Nikon picture comes from an HDMI capture card instead of Wi-Fi live view, should record and ISO still work? Find the picture source and the camera command session.

expected.must_mention: Picture source and PTP command service are separate; the record operation keeps its live-view preflight.

request: Changing ISO on the Insta360 Luna takes a few seconds and the control snaps back to the old value meanwhile. Where are Luna settings sent and read back?

expected.must_mention: Pending state must survive the readback delay without inventing success.

request: Frame.io delivery from the Nikon app fails while the phone is joined to the camera's Wi-Fi. Find the request planning and the network hop handling.

expected.must_mention: OAuth and secure storage stay app-owned; Pocket has a separate Frame.io implementation.

request: The chevron icons in OpenInstaCine's settings rows render slightly off-center. Fix them.

expected.must_mention: Insta's MonitorUI is a synced copy; plan the fix in Pocket (or opencine) and re-sync Insta.

request: OpenPocketCine's Luna I-Log look is too contrasty. Which LUT does it use?

expected.must_mention: Pocket has no Luna look; the Luna LUT is app-scoped to OpenInstaCine and not redistributable to shared packages.

request: Is Nikon multicam in the app that ships from main today?

expected.must_mention: No. It exists only on the unmerged engine-port branch; answering needs refs, not edits.

request: Has the OpenInstaCine Android app been tested with a real Luna camera?

expected.must_mention: Not verified on a physical Luna per the repo's own docs; report as untested, do not propose code.
